label: No placebo
rationale: This is a single-group interventional study where all participants receive the TENS intervention, with no placebo or sham comparator described. The design and arm text support an uncontrolled pre/post treatment study rather than a placebo-controlled trial.

evidence.quote: All 10 participants will receive a single TENS intervention
Following these assessments, participants will receive a single 30-minute TENS treatment.

title: Investigating the Impact of Electrical Stimulation on Facial Pain, Jaw Movement and Oral Health in People With Motor Neuron Disease.

rule.label: No placebo
rule.reason: All recorded arms have recognized non-placebo types and no placebo mention in arms/interventions. Inferred from saved data; sham controls count as no placebo.
